findings.problem: The card uses the usted register (puede), but the app's Spanish must be in the informal tú register, with usted taught only as a word card of its own.
findings.fix: es: ¿Me puedes ayudar, por favor? | hint: Informal (tú) | example.es: Perdón, ¿me puedes ayudar, por favor? No entiendo.

back.example: Sorry, can you help me, please? I don't understand.

note: With the formal hint, ¿Me podría ayudar, por favor? would also be a natural answer; the tú version has the same issue with ¿Me podrías ayudar?, so the editor could think about accepting the conditional form or making the hint rule it out.
